sentences.text: Researchers examined how antipsychotic medications and related compounds affect the system that moves thyroid hormones across cell membranes, finding that these drugs caused a significant rise in MCT8 protein, the main carrier for these hormones, in multiple cell lines.

The presence of halogen atoms attached to the drug molecules was essential for boosting MCT8 production, with the strength of the effect varying by halogen type and iodine-containing compounds causing the largest increase.
This rise in transporter protein was linked to a greater amount of fluorescent markers entering the cells, confirming that the transporters were actually working.
The authors state that this is the first known instance of a halogen atom controlling the expression of a protein in mammalian cells.
